Name: Add Shrek remove Shane
Author: haugesund
Description:
Why would Shrek be in Pelican Town?

Here's some lore:

Shane drank too much and had to be airlifted to Zuzu city state hospital where he perished. Meanwhile, Shrek shows up at Marnie's ranch. He is mistaken for Shane due to his smell, and the people of Stardew Valley just pretend Shane gained some weight and turned green. Because both Shane and Shrek have essentially the same personality, this was not very hard.

Manifest.Name: Shrek
Manifest.Description: Shrek is added, Shane is removed
